title: Establishment and application of real-world datasets for precocious puberty from electronic health records based on large language models

live_model.evidence: "The GPT-4 was able to retrieve specific content from the history of present illness and past medical history with accuracies of 81% and 94%, respectively [8]." (citation of a different, external study); "architectures like GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI) have the ability to perform assessments..." (Discussion, generic mention).

prompt.location: n/a for GPT-4/GPT-4 Turbo; the CRISPE-framework prompt (eTable 4) was built for and run against GLM-4-9B, not GPT-4

claim.metric: none for GPT-4; this paper's own extraction-accuracy results (medical history 90.9%, physical exam 96.3%, clinical diagnosis 97.6%, medical order 74.2%; eTable 5) are for GLM-4-9B on n=2,170 held-out EHRs
claim.location: Sec 2.6-2.8 and Results 3.1 (GLM-4-9B, with GLM-4-Plus reprocessing low-quality fields)

data.source: 10,846 children's EHRs from a single hospital; no public release found

notes: This paper's actual information-extraction pipeline runs open-source GLM-4-9B/GLM-4-Plus (Zhipu AI), not any OpenAI model. "GPT-4"/"GPT-4 Turbo" appear only in background/citation sentences (role C, 81%/94% figures belong to a different cited paper [8]).
